name: Nightly CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  cancel_previous:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: 'in_progress'

  go_test:
    needs: cancel_previous
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
      - name: Run Go tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          go test ./... -json > test-results/results.json
      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: test-results/results.json
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  pr_fast_gates:
    needs: go_test
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        gate:
          - gate1
          - gate2
          - gate3
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run ${{ matrix.gate }}
        run: |
          cd gates/${{ matrix.gate }}
          docker compose up --abort-on-container-exit
          docker compose down

  nightly_gates:
    needs: go_test
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        gate:
          - gate1
          - gate2
          - gate3
          - gate4
          - gate5
          - gate6
          - gate7
          - gate8
          - gate9
          - gate10
          - gate11
          - gate12
          - gate13
          - gate14
          - gate15
          - gate16
          - gate17
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run ${{ matrix.gate }}
        run: |
          cd gates/${{ matrix.gate }}
          docker compose up --abort-on-container-exit
          docker compose down

  slack_notify:
    needs: [go_test, pr_fast_gates, nightly_gates]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
          channel: '#ci'
          message: 'CI run finished for ${{ github.repository }}'
